summary: Completed testing of 3 fixes: P0 email_service.py syntax fix, P1 customer address/postcode display in Admin orders, P2 drag-and-drop category reordering. All backend tests passed (17/17). All frontend features working correctly.

GET /api/categories returns categories sorted by sort_order
GET /api/admin/categories returns categories with sort_order (requires admin auth)
POST /api/admin/categories/reorder updates category sort_order (requires admin auth)
Admin login flow works correctly (admin@laundry-express.co.uk / admin123)
Admin Orders tab shows customer address and postcode in each order card
Admin Orders tab shows pickup/delivery instructions if present
Admin Categories tab shows all 5 categories with drag handles
Category reorder persists and reflects on storefront /products page category tabs order
Admin can change order status from dropdown (Pending/Confirmed/Processing/Completed/Cancelled)
Admin stats display correctly (10 orders, £628.43 revenue, 2 businesses, 127 products)
